Package Model.World

Class HexTile

java.lang.Object
Model.World.HexTile
public class HexTile extends Object
This class represents a hex tile on the hex map A hex contains the following: pos: Coordinates climate: Climate of the tile elevation: Elevation of the tile (plain, mountains) terrain: terrain type (grassland, desert, etc.) entity: add-on (farm, resources, cities, etc.)
